verdict.rationale: HumanLayer is a platform for orchestrating agent tasks, so asking whether it ships official SDKs is a fair question. The evidence documents only a CLI (`humanlayer automation run`, remote daemons), workspace config files and third-party integrations, with no client libraries or SDK packages. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the CLI is a separate capability that does not count as an SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
